remaining: Byte canonical namespace, ByteError carrier, native-endian variants and lazy iterators still require exact per-row reconciliation;128 declarations do not prove all129 Byte catalog signatures.

Owning buffer operations now exist and have scoped transactional allocation-failure gates; their source signatures and errors must not be described as missing merely because the older107-function profile lacked them.
copy_within retains ascending unit-step Range restrictions and prevalidated bounds/overlap behavior; output allocation and UTF8 validation/copy costs remain explicit.
UTF8 decode can validate then validate/copy again in string.from_utf8; the profile does not promise one scan or zero allocation.
partial_contracts.evidence: Targeted f46a65b2 gate: expanded scalar and copy fixtures each pass check/AOT O0/O2/JIT O0/O2, four interface negatives, deterministic binary/hex allocation failure cleanup and nonallocating helper/copy probes. Python oracle covers all256 unary values, all65536 byte pairs/nibble pairs,45 contained ranges and1013 valid deposit fields per value, all256 binary strings and128 ASCII bytes in every position, and6048 open/closed/overlap/bounds copy cases. Per-row fingerprints are explicitly probabilistic compact checks, with direct unary/binary/error payload assertions. Earlier66-codec gate also covered all65536 f16/bf16 patterns, all16-bit integer patterns and wide independent Python goldens. The subsequent recorded f46a65b2 coherent120/120 suite includes this scoped gate; later additions require a new checkpoint.
partial_contracts.historical_available_source_surface: 107 ordinary bytes.* functions: explicit LE/BE signed/unsigned integer codecs through128bits, exact f16/bf16/f32/f64 representation codecs, scalar bit/count/shift/rotate/field operations, strict binary/hex, bounded lookup/fill/search and overlap-safe copy_within. Common imported ordering.Ordering has ten pure helpers and is reexported by bytes.
historical_remaining: 91 distinct Byte catalog names have source-name candidates, not exact contract completion. Imported bytes.ByteError and namespace spelling remain explicit; wide numeric/low-precision source extensions are tracked separately.
Native-endian codecs, owning buffer allocation/growth and lazy iterator contracts are not implemented merely by the107-function profile.

copy_within accepts checked open/closed ascending unit-step extents; ReversedRange and NonContiguousRange are distinct. Complete ranges are validated before mutation, strict text before allocation. Bitfield deposit rejects truncation.
Binary and hex string creation have explicit owned allocation; scalar helpers, endian codecs and in-place copy do not allocate. Target execution remains limited to actual platform gates.
partial_contracts.refresh_boundary: Proposal from current source/audits; historical text preserved separately; no new full-suite claim.

partial_contracts.available_source_surface: Core Char.from_u32/to_u32 plus explicit unicode107 source functions:105 non-Core alternatives with76 same return carriers and29 UnicodeError adaptations.
remaining: The105 non-Core Char namespace spellings remain unsupported; source alternatives require import unicode. This is a spelling/API reconciliation issue, not87 still-absent behavior providers.
Eight of the UCD50 operations use UnicodeError; Core CharError remains only InvalidScalar. All29 Char source carrier adaptations must stay explicit.
UCD17 property/name/case tables do not provide whole-string normalization, segmentation, bidi reordering, layout, terminal width, or locale/context-sensitive casing.
Preserve the original zero-dispatch audit historically and use char_source_checkpoint.json for current targeted evidence; full CPU completion is separate.
partial_contracts.evidence: See char_contract_audit.json for every107 catalog row, alternate provider, signature difference and source provenance. Direct107-call fixture was check-only; no invalid source was executed.
partial_contracts.historical_available_source_surface: 18 behavior-equivalent alternate source forms (17 ASCII char overloads and encoding.is_scalar), plus ascii.digit_value and char.parse with distinct error carriers. The audited compiler has no concrete Char.* catalog call dispatch.
historical_remaining: 37 Unicode-independent scalar, ASCII, bounded UTF, constant and escape operations require actual providers; Char.from_u32/to_u32 are key compiler prerequisites.
50 Unicode/profile/name/case/segmentation contracts require a pinned versioned dataset and explicit profile policies. ASCII implementations and host locale classification are not substitutes.
Existing encoding operations return u32/scalar/whole-text forms with EncodingError; this does not implicitly implement char-returning or bounded-buffer CharError contracts.
Scalar-only full-case mappings need a documented policy distinct from context/locale-sensitive string casing.
